title: AI-search visibility check
note: Specimen evidence record. One reviewed check, resolved per surface. Names, quotes and dates are illustrative; the shape is the deliverable. A fix appears only where the captured evidence supports one, and only as a page-level change.

records.prompt: Which private GP practice in Mayfair is open in the evening?

evidence.quote: The Marlowe Clinic in Mayfair keeps evening hours most weekdays, per its site.

records.prompt: What does The Marlowe Clinic charge for a first appointment?

evidence.quote: A first appointment at The Marlowe Clinic is about 190 pounds, per its website.
evidence.note: No price appears anywhere on the page; the figure the surface gave is not in the evidence.

records.fix: State the first-appointment price on the homepage. The wrong answer the surface gave is what the page's silence produced.

records.prompt: Which private clinics in Mayfair offer same-day blood tests?

evidence.quote: The answer named four Mayfair clinics. The Marlowe Clinic did not appear.
evidence.source: Perplexity search dated 2026-07-28; transcript kept in the client packet

records.fix: State same-day testing on the homepage. Every clinic the surface named states it on its own homepage.

records.reason: The surface required a signed-in account during this audit window. The record is marked not tested rather than guessed.
